 Florian Bartunek – Equities in Brazil at Constellation Asset Management (Manager Meetings, EP.27) 
 
 Florian Bartunek – Equities in Brazil at Constellation Asset Management (Manager Meetings, EP.27) Jan 20, 2022

 On today’s Manager Meeting, Greg Dowling interviews Florian
Bartunek. Greg is the Co-CIO and Head of Research for Fund
Evaluation Group, an institutional OCIO and investment consultant
with $83 billion in assets under advisement.

Florian is the founding partner and CIO of Constellation Asset
Management, a long-only asset manager focused on Brazil with
approximately $3 billion in AUM. Florian founded Constellation in
1999 alongside Jorge Paulo Lemann and 3G and brought in Steve
Mandel’s Lone Pine Capital as a partner in 2007.

Their conversation starts with Florian’s career in investment
management, his passion for reading, and an overview of Brazil’s
business environment and equity market. They then turn to
Constellation’s investment philosophy, team, portfolio
construction, and investment examples. Lastly, Florian discussed
opportunities and risks in Brazil, and his prediction for Brazil in
the next World Cup.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
